<html intID="21"><![CDATA[
<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function () {

  const OCCURRED_PREFIXES = ['A309_', 'A309['];
  // Matrices: support both underscore and bracket forms; A302 rows also include ZE07_XX fields
  const MATRICES = [
    { prefixes: ['A301_', 'A301['], altPrefixes: [] },
    { prefixes: ['A302_', 'A302['], altPrefixes: ['ZE07_', 'ZE07['] },
    { prefixes: ['A303_', 'A303['], altPrefixes: [] }
  ];
  const HIDE_ROWS = true;   // false: keep non-applicable rows visible but disabled/greyed

  const esc = s => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  const two = s => { s = String(s); return s.length === 1 ? '0' + s : s; };

  // Collect distinct control names/ids 
  function collectNames(prefixes) {
    const set = new Set();
    prefixes.forEach(pfx => {
      document.querySelectorAll('[name^="'+pfx+'"], [id^="'+pfx+'"]').forEach(el => {
        set.add(el.getAttribute('name') || el.id);
      });
    });
    return Array.from(set);
  }

  // A309: selected if (checkbox checked) OR (checked control has value "2") OR (hidden/select has value "2")
  function getSelectedCodes() {
    const selected = new Set();
    const names = collectNames(OCCURRED_PREFIXES);

    names.forEach(name => {
      // match A309_01 or A309[01]
      const m = name.match(/A309[_\[](\d{1,2})\b/);
      if (!m) return;
      const code = two(m[1]);

      const group = document.getElementsByName(name);
      let on = false;
      if (group && group.length) {
        for (const el of group) {
          const t = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();
          if (t === 'checkbox' && el.checked) { on = true; break; }
          if ((t === 'radio' || t === 'checkbox') && el.checked && el.value === '2') { on = true; break; }
          if (t === 'hidden' && el.value === '2') { on = true; }
          if (el.tagName === 'SELECT' && el.value === '2') { on = true; break; }
        }
      } else {
        // fallback: single element (via id)
        const el = document.getElementById(name);
        if (el) {
          const t = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();
          on = (t === 'checkbox' && el.checked) ||
               ((t === 'radio' || t === 'checkbox') && el.checked && el.value === '2') ||
               (t === 'hidden' && el.value === '2') ||
               (el.tagName === 'SELECT' && el.value === '2');
        }
      }
      if (on) selected.add(code);
    });
    return selected;
  }

   function codeFrom(nameOrId, prefix) {
    // 1) underscore style:  PREFIX + (1..2 digits) + [end or '_' or '[']
    let re = new RegExp('^' + esc(prefix) + '(\\d{1,2})(?:$|_|\\[)');
    let m  = (nameOrId || '').match(re);
    if (m) return two(m[1]);

    // 2) bracket style: PREFIX + '[' + (digits) + ']' + (optional '[' or end)
    if (prefix.endsWith('[')) {
      re = new RegExp('^' + esc(prefix) + '(\\d{1,2})\\](?:$|\\[|_)');
      m  = (nameOrId || '').match(re);
      if (m) return two(m[1]);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function collectRows(prefixes, altPrefixes) {
    const map = new Map();

    function addByPrefix(pfx) {
      document.querySelectorAll('[name^="'+pfx+'"], [id^="'+pfx+'"]').forEach(el => {
        const key = codeFrom(el.getAttribute('name') || el.id, pfx);
        if (!key) return;
        // find the row container; for matrices this is TR, but fall back to nearest block if no TR
        let row = el.closest('tr');
        if (!row) {
          // fallback: SoSci sometimes uses div-based layouts for custom inputs
          row = el.closest('.sosci-question, .question, .content, .row, div');
        }
        if (!row) return;
        if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, row);
      });
    }

    prefixes.forEach(addByPrefix);
    (altPrefixes || []).forEach(addByPrefix);
    return map;
  }

  function clearAndDisable(container, disabled) {
    container.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(el => {
      const t = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();
      if (t === 'hidden') return;                      // keep hidden counters
      const nm = el.name || '';
      if (/_CN\b/.test(nm) || /\[CN\]$/.test(nm)) return;  // keep *_CN fields

      if (disabled) {
        if (t === 'checkbox' || t === 'radio') el.checked = false;
        else if (el.tagName === 'SELECT') el.selectedIndex = -1;
        else el.value = '';
      }
      el.disabled = disabled;
    });
  }

  function applyFilter() {
    const sel = getSelectedCodes();

    MATRICES.forEach(cfg => {
      const rows = collectRows(cfg.prefixes, cfg.altPrefixes);
      rows.forEach((row, code) => {
        const active = sel.has(code);
        if (active) {
          if (HIDE_ROWS) row.style.display = '';
          row.style.opacity = '';
          clearAndDisable(row, false);
        } else {
          clearAndDisable(row, true);
          row.style.opacity = '0.4';
          if (HIDE_ROWS) row.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  }

  applyFilter();

  // Re-apply when any A309 element changes
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    const n = (e.target && (e.target.name || e.target.id)) || '';
    if (n.startsWith('A309_') || n.startsWith('A309[')) applyFilter();
  });
});
</script>

<html intID="13"><![CDATA[
<script>

window.addEventListener('load', function () {
  // ---- CONFIG ----
  const OCCURRED_PREFIXES = ['A405_', 'A405['];     // occurred checklist
  const A402_PREFIXES     = ['A402_', 'A402['];     // follow-up rows
  const HIDE_ROWS         = true;                   // false => grey/disable instead of hide

  // Map A405 code -> A402 row code (exactly like muscle twitching)
  function mapA405toA402(code) {
    if (code === '10') return '12'; // Local pain/discomfort -> A402_12 (like A402_09 for muscle)
    return code;                    // 01..09 map to themselves (e.g., 09 -> 09)
  }

  // Never render this A402 row (duplicate header for local pain)
  const ALWAYS_SUPPRESS_A402 = new Set(['11']);

  // ---- HELPERS ----
  const esc = s => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  const two = s => { s = String(s); return s.length === 1 ? '0' + s : s; };

  function collectNames(prefixes) {
    const set = new Set();
    prefixes.forEach(pfx => {
      document.querySelectorAll('[name^="'+pfx+'"], [id^="'+pfx+'"]').forEach(el => {
        set.add(el.getAttribute('name') || el.id);
      });
    });
    return Array.from(set);
  }

  // Read selected codes from A405 (2 = selected)
  function getSelectedA405() {
    const selected = new Set();
    collectNames(OCCURRED_PREFIXES).forEach(name => {
      const m = name.match(/A405[_\[](\d{1,2})\b/);
      if (!m) return;
      const code = two(m[1]);
      const group = document.getElementsByName(name);
      let on = false;
      if (group && group.length) {
        for (const el of group) {
          const t = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();
          if (t === 'checkbox' && el.checked) { on = true; break; }
          if ((t === 'radio' || t === 'checkbox') && el.checked && el.value === '2') { on = true; break; }
          if (t === 'hidden' && el.value === '2') { on = true; }
          if (el.tagName === 'SELECT' && el.value === '2') { on = true; break; }
        }
      }
      if (on) selected.add(code);
    });
    return selected;
  }

  // Extract A402 row code from name/id (supports underscore & bracket)
  function a402CodeFrom(nameOrId, prefix) {
    let re = new RegExp('^' + esc(prefix) + '(\\d{1,2})(?:$|_|\\[)');      // A402_12 or A402_12_1
    let m  = (nameOrId || '').match(re);
    if (m) return two(m[1]);
    if (prefix.endsWith('[')) {
      re = new RegExp('^' + esc(prefix) + '(\\d{1,2})\\](?:$|\\[|_)');    // A402[12] or A402[12][1]
      m  = (nameOrId || '').match(re);
      if (m) return two(m[1]);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function findRowContainer(el) {
    let row = el.closest('tr');
    if (row) return row;
    return el.closest('.sosci-question, .question, .content, .row, div') || el.parentElement;
  }

  // Group A402 rows by code (01..12)
  function collectA402Rows() {
    const map = new Map();
    A402_PREFIXES.forEach(pfx => {
      document.querySelectorAll('[name^="'+pfx+'"], [id^="'+pfx+'"]').forEach(el => {
        const nm = el.getAttribute('name') || el.id || '';
        if (/_CN\b/.test(nm) || /\[CN\]$/.test(nm)) return; // ignore counters/hidden
        const key = a402CodeFrom(nm, pfx);
        if (!key) return;
        const row = findRowContainer(el);
        if (!row) return;
        if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, new Set());
        map.get(key).add(row);
      });
    });
    return map; // Map<'01'..'12', Set<rowElements>>
  }

  function clearAndDisable(container, disabled) {
    container.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(el => {
      const t = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();
      const nm = el.name || '';
      if (t === 'hidden') return;
      if (/_CN\b/.test(nm) || /\[CN\]$/.test(nm)) return;
      if (disabled) {
        if (t === 'checkbox' || t === 'radio') el.checked = false;
        else if (el.tagName === 'SELECT') el.selectedIndex = -1;
        else el.value = '';
      }
      el.disabled = disabled;
    });
  }

  function applyFilter() {
    // Build the set of A402 rows to show from selected A405 items
    const selected = getSelectedA405();                 // e.g., {"08","09","10"}
    const toShow   = new Set();

    selected.forEach(a405 => {
      const a402 = mapA405toA402(a405);                // "10" -> "12", "09"->"09", others identity
      if (!ALWAYS_SUPPRESS_A402.has(a402)) toShow.add(a402);
    });

    // Toggle A402 rows
    const rowsByCode = collectA402Rows();
    rowsByCode.forEach((rowSet, code) => {
      const show = toShow.has(code) && !ALWAYS_SUPPRESS_A402.has(code);
      rowSet.forEach(row => {
        if (show) {
          if (HIDE_ROWS) row.style.display = '';
          row.style.opacity = '';
          clearAndDisable(row, false);   // enable all inputs in that row (incl. ZE03/ZE04 if present)
        } else {
          clearAndDisable(row, true);
          row.style.opacity = '0.4';
          if (HIDE_ROWS) row.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  }

  applyFilter();
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    const n = (e.target && (e.target.name || e.target.id)) || '';
    if (n.startsWith('A405_') || n.startsWith('A405[')) applyFilter();
  });
});
</script>
]]></html>
